dedupe_keys.name: aceee state and local policy database buildings and energy efficiency policy

description: ACEEE's State and Local Policy Database describes energy efficiency policies in force in US states and cities across government, utilities, transportation, buildings, combined heat and power and appliance standards, and is updated at least once a year with data gathered for ACEEE's State and City Energy Efficiency Scorecards. The buildings summary explains why building codes matter and gives a paragraph per state on whether residential and commercial codes are mandatory, which IECC or ASHRAE 90.1 edition they reference, state amendments, limits on stricter local codes and compliance and enforcement activity; for example it notes that Alabama has mandatory codes referencing the 2015 IECC and a May 2024 law banning more stringent local energy codes. City pages cover local building policies such as benchmarking and performance standards. Coverage: US states and scored cities. Access: free web database with a clickable map. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: narrative text, not a structured download, written by an advocacy research organisation. Simulation uses: encoding current code editions and policies in state and city building stock scenarios. Related records: the DOE state energy code adoption status and the State Climate Policy Dashboard.
